projection_order: existing immutable scene/report/source/history validation, then provider-only projection

source_roles.attested_server_facts: Resolved report and receipt define mechanical facts; decoded JSON preserves values.
source_roles.current_declarations: Declared attempts and speech, not automatic outcomes.
source_roles.stable_context: Mission map/setting/world when supplied; context source hash references prevent duplicated setting text.
source_roles.characters: Profile/voice separate from gesture repertoire, possible conduct and private authored background.
source_roles.phase_possibilities: Original transition condition and candidate consequence are conditional, never promoted to current facts.
source_roles.acquired_history: Exact published events with IDs, hashes, sequence; source aliases use equality of verified body hashes.
source_roles.private_memory_output: Same Generation returns memory bound through the actual run/request/source/result receipts; never gameplay authority.

history_bootstrap: Use actual stored memory when present; otherwise null plus verified published events. No manual summary, fixture or second model call.
limits: Existing memory capacities only; no semantic gate, mandatory reaction, phrase ban, invented damage, new mechanics or state transition.
not_proved_by_one_preview: editorial success before actual Staff result review
